refusals.wcag-refusal-sql-perf: This Postgres query takes about 9 seconds on a 40-million-row orders table: SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50; What index or rewrite would make it fast?
